description: This file defines a NotesModel for managing notes, including creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting notes, with handling of associated tags via a join table. It interacts with a database using SQL queries and exports the model for external use.

methods.name: attachTags
methods.description: Fetches and attaches tags to a note object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional tags and returns the created note with tags attached.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, including associated tags.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes with optional filters, sorting, and pagination, including tags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a note's fields and tags, returning the updated note.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
